description: Hash identifier and password-storage audit — Identify a hash or password-hash string offline (hash=): bcrypt, Argon2, scrypt, yescrypt, sha512crypt, md5crypt, phpass, PBKDF2 (passlib/Django), LDAP schemes, MySQL, NTLM, MD5/SHA-1/SHA-2/SHA-3 by length, base64 digests, JWTs and EVM hashes. Parses cost/memory/iterations and rates password storage STRONG/ACCEPTABLE/WEAK/UNSUITABLE against OWASP guidance. Nothing is cracked. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_hash_identify
